description: This file defines the interface 'EntitlementConsumptionStrategy' for handling leave entitlement consumption logic within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for creating, canceling, and changing leave entitlements, as well as retrieving leave periods and date limits related to leave without entitlements.

classes.name: EntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing leave entitlement consumption, including handling leave creation, cancellation, period changes, and retrieving leave periods and date limits.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a leave record for an employee, returning current and change entitlement details.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave, returning updated entitlement information.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the leave period, given old and new start dates.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Retrieves date limits for leave without entitlements within a specified leave balance period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period for a specific date, employee, and leave type.
